replies.text: Noted: your shop is in Los Angeles.
Got it: your customers love Skims, Bad Bunny and Euphoria.
Quick check: by "Le Labo" do you mean Le Labo Fragrances? (Le Labo Fragrances is a niche perfume and candle brand known for hand-formulated perfumes, slow perfumery, …)

Drop #01 is ready: 11 to stock, 3 to consider, 9 to skip. Top picks: Glossier, Birkenstock, Herschel Supply Co and Hydro Flask. A generic bestseller list would have made the opposite call on Boy Smells, Blundstone and HAY. That is where your crowd differs from the average shopper.
